# CI requirements for test_all_platforms.py
#
# The core TTS engine (sandhi, metre, phonetics, prosody, G2P constants)
# uses the Python standard library only — no third-party packages are needed
# to run the offline pronunciation test suite.
#
# Optional packages below give fuller test coverage:
#   • Morfessor  — enables statistical morpheme segmentation (Section K)
#                  without it, MarathiMorphologicalAnalyzer falls back to
#                  rule-based only (still tested)
#   • indicnlp   — enables TextNormalizer / GrammarEngine / number_to_words
#                  tests (Sections I, J, K); without it those sections are
#                  automatically SKIPPED (not failed)
#
# Heavy packages (torch, tensorflow, gTTS, pydub, librosa, etc.) are NOT
# needed here — they are only required for the production web server.

Morfessor>=2.0.6
